name: Unmaker, Unmimic
body:
UNMAKER, UNMIMIC
CR 12

XP 19,200
CE Medium outsider (native, psionic, unmaker)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., lifesense 120 ft.; Perception +20; Aura discord (60 ft., DC 21), empathic understanding (30 ft., DC 19)

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 21, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +6 deflection)
hp 110 (13d10+39); regeneration 5
Fort +11, Ref +9, Will +12
Defensive Abilities ruinous shield; DR 5/-; Immune cold; PR 23
Weaknesses unstable resolve

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +16 (1d8+3 force damage)
Special Attacks lock perception
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 11th; concentration +17)

Constant—empathic understanding (DC 19, can detect lies)
At will—aversion (DC 22, 15 hours), cloud mind (DC 22, 11 creatures), compelling voice (DC 22, 5 rounds), complex false sensory input* (DC 22, 3 senses), empathic connection (DC 22, affects all eligible creatures, 1 day/level), feign familiarity (DC 22, 14 targets, no automatic break), memory modification (DC 20), mind probe (DC 22)
3/day—insurrection (DC 22, 5 targets, 50%), moment of terror (DC 20, penalty regardless), obsession (DC 22, causes Wisdom damage)
1/day—assign imperative (DC 22), energy current (11d6–11, DC 22), latent programming (DC 22) (powers do not include the +2 DC bonus from Greater Psionic Endowment)

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 21, Con 16, Int 18, Wis 19, Cha 22
Base Atk +13; CMB +16; CMD 37
Feats Ability Focus (lock perception), Deceitful, Greater Psionic Endowment, Improved Initiative, Power Penetration, Psionic Endowment Skills Bluff +26, Diplomacy +22, Disguise +26, Intimidate +22, Knowledge (local) +20, Knowledge (planes) +20, Knowledge (psionics) +20, Perception +20, Sense Motive +17, Spellcraft +20
Languages telepathy 100 ft., truespeech
SQ change shape (minor metamorphosis), no breath, steal identity

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Discord Aura (Su)

All creatures within 60 feet of an unmimic become untrustworthy and difficult to interact with. Creatures that fail a DC 22 Will save are no longer treated as allies to other creatures and cannot provide flanking, use or benefit from teamwork feats or aid another actions, or allow other creatures to move through their space. Any power or effect that requires a willing target fails if used on an affected creature, and even harmless effects require an attack roll (if applicable) and require affected creatures to attempt a saving throw to resist their effects (if a save is allowed).

In addition, all creatures who fail their save are treated as one step less friendly for the purpose of Diplomacy checks. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Lock Perception (Su)

Any creature that an unmimic succeeds at a Bluff or Diplomacy check against becomes permanently rooted in their belief. Whenever such a check succeeds, any targets attempt a DC 24 Will save. On a failed save, no action or event can make the target realize they were lied to or make it more hostile to the unmimic. This is a mind-affecting curse effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Steal Identity (Su)

When a creature fails their save against an unmimic’s mind probe psi-like ability, the unmimic learns how to replicate the target creature flawlessly. It can take the shape of the creature using its change shape ability (as far as the shape can be replicated with minor metamorphosis), gaining a +20 bonus on all Disguise checks to pretend to be that creature. Having read the creature’s thoughts thoroughly, the unmimic knows everything that the original creature did at the time it was read.

ABOUT

Unmimics act as spies and infiltrators, directly combatting those who would utilize guile or social aptitude to combat the unmakers. A well-placed unmimic or squad of unmimics can tear apart an enemy faction before they can even mount an offensive.
